name: context-bar
description: One bar above the prompt: context used, what each turn re-reads from cache vs fresh, cache warm/cold with time left, and a hold before a cold rewrite.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: Idle time after which the prompt cache is treated as cold.

holdMinTokensK.title: Hold above (k tokens)
holdMinTokensK.description: Only hold a prompt when at least this much context would be rewritten.

warnAtK.title: Context warning (k tokens)
warnAtK.description: Toast and turn the bar yellow past this size.

alertAtK.title: Context alert (k tokens)
alertAtK.description: Toast and turn the bar red past this size.

handoffCommand.title: Hand off command
handoffCommand.description: Put in the prompt by the Hand off first button.
